summary: We developed "Abandoned but not Forgotten," an immersive 3D narrative and interactive UI exploration game built in Godot 3.4 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project directly addresses the challenge by providing a comprehensive archival and interactive system where users can explore the histories of legendary space missions, choose specific machines and lost rovers on Mars and the Moon (such as Sojourner, Opportunity, Ingenuity, Viking, and NEAR Shoemaker), and experience their stories. It is important because it honors humanity's lost space pioneers, preserves their legacy, and bridges planetary science with engaging interactive education.
details:
Abandoned but not Forgotten" features a dual-layer experience: an advanced interactive UI hub displaying official NASA mission archives, years of operation, and authentic preview cards, paired with a 3D exploration environment.

  • How it works: Users navigate through a sleek sidebar menu to select historical rovers and landers across the Moon and Mars. Selecting a machine pulls up its real NASA science data and triggers immersive 3D sequences
  • Benefits & Goals: The project educates users on space exploration history, Martian and lunar missions, and mission milestones through a seamless blend of UI design and narrative gameplay.
  • Tools & Technologies: Developed using Godot 3.4 (GDScript), Blender for 3D assets and CapCut for promotional video editing.
